planted.what: get_invoice reads role from body.get("role", user.role) instead of only trusting the session's own role, so the caller can supply its own role
planted.quote: The authorization check trusts a `role` field taken from the **request body** — data the client controls — instead of from the authenticated session.

planted.what: a plain authenticated customer, sending {"role": "admin"} in the body, can read another customer's invoice
planted.quote: Any logged-in customer can view **any** invoice (and anyone else's billing data) just by adding `{"role": "admin"}` to their request:

planted.what: the fix is to use the session's own role and ignore any role field the client sends
planted.quote: **Fix:** authorize off the session only. Delete the body-role path.

traps.what: get_price has no authentication check at all, but this is intentional and documented in README.md — a public catalog mirroring what's already posted in stores, not a finding
